g.text: Retained pairs have neither protein in the named exposure list; all 12 models use the same rows within each test.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526071

g.text: Dashed lines: AP = subset positive fraction; AUROC = 0.5. Point estimates only; no confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526071

g.text: Both exposure lists are applied together; about 2% of each full test remains. Homology and pretraining exposure are not filtered.
